def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    entity_list = list(entity_ids)
    features = pd.DataFrame(index=entity_list)

    order_items = db['order_items']
    orders = db['orders']
    reviews = db['reviews']

    feature_names = [
        'n_orders', 'n_items', 'total_sales', 'avg_price', 'std_price',
        'avg_freight', 'std_freight', 'freight_ratio', 'n_sellers',
        'days_since_first', 'days_since_last', 'lifetime_days', 'has_sales',
        'avg_review_score', 'std_review_score', 'n_reviews',
        'n_reviews_neg', 'days_since_last_review', 'recent_review_score',
        'n_orders_last_30', 'n_orders_last_60', 'n_orders_last_90',
        'n_orders_prev_90', 'sales_ratio_90', 'sales_ratio_30_60',
        'trend_last60_vs_prev', 'n_delivered', 'avg_delivery_days',
        'n_late_estimated', 'n_orders_current_half', 'n_orders_prev_half'
    ]
    for f in feature_names:
        features[f] = 0.0

    # Только позиции, реально существующие на момент seed_time
    mask = (order_items['product_id'].isin(entity_list)) & (order_items['ts'] <= seed_time)
    items = order_items[mask].copy()

    if not items.empty:
        agg = items.groupby('product_id').agg(
            n_orders=('order_id', 'nunique'),
            n_items=('order_id', 'size'),
            total_sales=('price', 'sum'),
            avg_price=('price', 'mean'),
            std_price=('price', 'std'),
            avg_freight=('freight_value', 'mean'),
            std_freight=('freight_value', 'std'),
            n_sellers=('seller_id', 'nunique'),
            first_purchase=('ts', 'min'),
            last_purchase=('ts', 'max')
        )
        agg['freight_ratio'] = agg['avg_freight'] / (agg['avg_price'] + 1e-9)
        agg['days_since_first'] = (seed_time - agg['first_purchase']).dt.days
        agg['days_since_last'] = (seed_time - agg['last_purchase']).dt.days
        agg['lifetime_days'] = (agg['last_purchase'] - agg['first_purchase']).dt.days
        agg['has_sales'] = 1.0

        base_cols = [c for c in agg.columns if c in features.columns]
        features.loc[agg.index, base_cols] = agg[base_cols].values

        # Периоды продаж
        per_counts = {}
        for period in [30, 60, 90, 180]:
            cutoff = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=period)
            sub = items[items['ts'] >= cutoff]
            per_counts[period] = sub.groupby('product_id')['order_id'].nunique()
            features.loc[per_counts[period].index, f'n_orders_last_{period}'] = \
                per_counts[period].values.astype(float)

        prev90 = items[items['ts'] < seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)]
        per_counts['prev90'] = prev90.groupby('product_id')['order_id'].nunique()
        features.loc[per_counts['prev90'].index, 'n_orders_prev_90'] = \
            per_counts['prev90'].values.astype(float)

        # Отношения активности (тренд/недавность)
        r30 = per_counts[30]
        r90 = per_counts[90]
        p90 = per_counts['prev90']
        ratio90 = (r90 + 1.0) / (p90 + 1.0)
        features.loc[ratio90.index, 'sales_ratio_90'] = ratio90.values

        r60 = per_counts[60]
        l30 = r30.reindex(r60.index).fillna(0.0)
        p30_60 = (r60 - l30).clip(lower=0.0)
        ratio3060 = (l30 + 0.5) / (p30_60 + 0.5)
        features.loc[ratio3060.index, 'sales_ratio_30_60'] = ratio3060.values

        cur_half = items[items['ts'] > seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=180)] \
            .groupby('product_id')['order_id'].nunique()
        prev_half = p90.reindex(r90.index).fillna(0.0)
        c_half = cur_half.reindex(r90.index).fillna(0.0)
        tr = (c_half + 1.0) / (prev_half + 1.0)
        features.loc[tr.index, 'trend_last60_vs_prev'] = tr.values

        # Отзывы: только те, что созданы до seed_time (отзыв пишется позже покупки)
        ord_reviews = reviews[reviews['review_creation_date'] <= seed_time][
            ['order_id', 'review_score']]
        prod_rev = items[['product_id', 'order_id']].drop_duplicates() \
            .merge(ord_reviews, on='order_id', how='inner')
        if not prod_rev.empty:
            rev_agg = prod_rev.groupby('product_id')['review_score'] \
                .agg(['mean', 'std', 'count', 'sum'])
            neg = prod_rev[prod_rev['review_score'] <= 2] \
                .groupby('product_id')['review_score'].count()
            features.loc[rev_agg.index, 'avg_review_score'] = rev_agg['mean']
            features.loc[rev_agg.index, 'std_review_score'] = rev_agg['std'].fillna(0.0)
            features.loc[rev_agg.index, 'n_reviews'] = rev_agg['count']
            features.loc[neg.index, 'n_reviews_neg'] = neg.values.astype(float)

            rev_times = reviews[reviews['review_creation_date'] <= seed_time][
                ['order_id', 'review_score', 'review_creation_date']]
            rt = items[['product_id', 'order_id']].drop_duplicates() \
                .merge(rev_times, on='order_id', how='inner')
            last_rev = rt.loc[rt.groupby('product_id')['review_creation_date'].idxmax()]
            features.loc[last_rev['product_id'], 'days_since_last_review'] = \
                (seed_time - last_rev['review_creation_date']).dt.days.values
            features.loc[last_rev['product_id'], 'recent_review_score'] = \
                last_rev['review_score'].values.astype(float)

        # Информация о заказах: только события, произошедшие до seed_time
        prod_orders = items[['product_id', 'order_id']].drop_duplicates() \
            .merge(orders, on='order_id', how='inner')
        if not prod_orders.empty:
            po = prod_orders.copy()
            # доставка завершена, только если дата доставки <= seed_time
            po['delivered'] = po['order_delivered_customer_date'].notna() & \
                (po['order_delivered_customer_date'] <= seed_time)
            delivered = po[po['delivered']].copy()
            features.loc[delivered.groupby('product_id').size().index, 'n_delivered'] = \
                delivered.groupby('product_id').size().values.astype(float)

            d_ok = delivered.dropna(subset=['order_delivered_customer_date'])
            dd = d_ok[(d_ok['order_purchase_timestamp'].notna())]
            speed = (dd['order_delivered_customer_date'] -
                     dd['order_purchase_timestamp']).dt.days
            avg_speed = speed.groupby(dd['product_id']).mean()
            features.loc[avg_speed.index, 'avg_delivery_days'] = avg_speed.values

            late = d_ok[d_ok['order_delivered_customer_date'] >
                        d_ok['order_estimated_delivery_date']] \
                .groupby('product_id').size()
            features.loc[late.index, 'n_late_estimated'] = late.values.astype(float)

            # продажи в первой/второй половине последнего года
            yr = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=365)
            half = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=182)
            cur = items[(items['ts'] > half)].groupby('product_id')['order_id'].nunique()
            prv = items[(items['ts'] > yr) & (items['ts'] <= half)] \
                .groupby('product_id')['order_id'].nunique()
            features.loc[cur.index, 'n_orders_current_half'] = cur.values.astype(float)
            features.loc[prv.index, 'n_orders_prev_half'] = prv.values.astype(float)

    features = features.apply(pd.to_numeric, errors='coerce')
    features = features.fillna(0.0)
    features = features.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 0.0)
    features = features.reindex(entity_list)
    return features
